{{Short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2022–23 |team=NC State Wolfpack |sport=Basketball |image=North Carolina State University Athletic logo.svg |image_size=100 |conference=Atlantic Coast Conference |division= |short_conf=ACC |record= 23–11 |conf_record= 12–8 |APRank= |CoachRank= |head_coach=[[Kevin Keatts]] |hc_year = 6th |asst_coach1=Levi Watkins |asst_coach2=[[Kareem Richardson]] |asst_coach3=Joel Justus |stadium=[[PNC Arena]] |tourney=[[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result=First Round }} {{2022–23 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team''' represented [[North Carolina State University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Wolfpack were led by sixth-year head coach [[Kevin Keatts]] and played their home games at [[PNC Arena]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). They finished the season 23–11, 12–8 in [[2022–23 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in sixth place. They defeated [[2022–23 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]] before losing to [[2022–23 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] in the [[2023 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 11 seed in the South region. There they lost to [[2022–23 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] in the first round. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|Wolfpack]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 11–21, 4–16 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 15th place. In the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they lost to [[2021–22 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] in the first round. ==Offseason== ===Departures===
